records.jp: すりすり。えへへ
records.en_original: Nuzzle nuzzle. Ehehe.
records.en: Nuzzle nuzzle. Ehehe.

records.jp: え？　愛央、いきなりどうしたの？
records.en_original: Huh? What are you doing, Ao?
records.en: Huh? What are you doing, Ao?

records.jp: えへ。<CR>このベッドがロマンチックだから、つい
records.en_original: Eheh. This bed feels kinda romantic, so I just...
records.en: Eheh. This bed feels kinda romantic, so I just...

records.jp: 愛央。相手が私だからいいけど、<CR>むやみに雰囲気に流されちゃ駄目よ
records.en_original: Ao. It's fine this time because it's me, but you shouldn't let yourself get carried away like that.
records.en: Ao. It's fine this time because it's me, but you shouldn't let yourself get carried away like that.

records.jp: うっ。はーい
records.en_original: Aww, okay...
records.en: Aww, okay...

records.jp: でも、今日は特別に許してあげる
records.en_original: But, I'll make a special allowance for today.
records.en: But, I'll make a special allowance for today.

records.jp: わたし一人っ子だから、<CR>お姉さんに甘えたくなって？
records.en_original: I'm an only child. I've always wanted to have a big sister to coddle me.
records.en: I'm an only child, so I wanted to lean on an older sister.

records.jp: それじゃ、<CR>『お姉さん』に甘えてみた感想は？
records.en_original: Well, how does it feel to be coddled by your "big sister"?
records.en: So, how did it feel to lean on an 'older sister'?

records.jp: あったかくていい匂い〜
records.en_original: Warm... And you smell good.
records.en: Warm... And you smell good.

records.jp: それは、『お姉さん』と関係ない気がするん<CR>だけど？
records.en_original: I don't think that has anything to do with being a big sister...
records.en: I don't think that has anything to do with being an 'older sister'...

records.jp: ここに寝てると、なんだか夜空の中にいる<CR>みたいで、いいなぁ
records.en_original: I feel like I've plunged into the night sky when I sleep here. It's nice.
records.en: I feel like I've plunged into the night sky when I sleep here. It's nice.

records.jp: 夜空、ねぇ……
records.en_original: Mm, the night sky...
records.en: Mm, the night sky...

records.jp: えっ？
records.en_original: Hmm?
records.en: Hmm?

records.jp: もしかして、美弦さんは夜空嫌いなの？
records.en_original: Do you not like the night sky, Mio?
records.en: Do you not like the night sky, Mio-san?

records.jp: え？　いいえ、好きよ
records.en_original: Huh? No, I do...
records.en: Huh? No, I do...

records.jp: でも、いま……
records.en_original: But, just now...
records.en: But, just now...

records.jp: ああ。ごめんなさい。<CR>本物の夜空の方が好きかな、と思って
records.en_original: Ah, I'm sorry. I was just thinking that I like the real night sky better.
records.en: Ah, I'm sorry. I was just thinking that I like the real night sky better.

records.jp: あ。もしかして、このベッドじゃ<CR>お眼鏡に適わない、とか？
records.en_original: Oh, let me guess. You don't like this bed?
records.en: Oh, let me guess. You don't like this bed?

records.jp: ごめんね。でも当たり
records.en_original: I'm sorry. But, that's right...
records.en: I'm sorry. But, that's right...

records.jp: やっぱ、ちょっと子供っぽいかぁ
records.en_original: This is a little childish, isn't it?
records.en: This is a little childish, isn't it?

records.jp: でも、愛央とこうしていると、<CR>何だかほっとする
records.en_original: But, being with you like this...feels quite comforting.
records.en: But, being with you like this...feels quite comforting.

records.jp: 私も……ふあぁ……
records.en_original: Me too... *Yawn*...
records.en: Me too... *Yawn*...

records.jp: わわっ。私、寝ちゃってた！？
records.en_original: Huh?! Did I fall asleep?!
records.en: Huh?! Did I fall asleep?!

records.jp: ふふ。おはよう、愛央
records.en_original: Hehe. Good morning to you too, Ao.
records.en: Hehe. Good morning to you too, Ao.

records.jp: しかも私、美弦さんに抱きついてたよね！？
records.en_original: And wait, I was cuddling you, wasn't I?!
records.en: And I was clinging to you, Mio-san, wasn't I?!

records.jp: ええ。私も抱き枕にさせてもらってたわ。<CR>愛央、抱き心地がとても良くて
records.en_original: That's right. I used you as a body pillow too. You're very comfortable, Ao.
records.en: That's right. I used you as a body pillow too. You're very comfortable, Ao.

records.jp: うぅ……<CR>ならよかった、のかな
records.en_original: Urk... That's good, I guess.
records.en: Urk... That's good, I guess.

records.jp: しっかり抱えちゃっていたけど、<CR>愛央は、寝苦しくなかった？
records.en_original: I was holding you pretty tightly. Did you have any trouble sleeping?
records.en: I was holding you pretty tightly. Did you have any trouble sleeping?

records.jp: 大丈夫！<CR>それより私、ヨダレとか垂れてなかった！？
records.en_original: Not at all! I wasn't drooling, was I?!
records.en: Not at all! I wasn't drooling, was I?!

records.jp: その心配はないみたい
records.en_original: It doesn't look like it.
records.en: It doesn't look like it.

records.jp: よ、よかった〜〜〜！
records.en_original: Oh, phew!
records.en: Oh, phew!

records.jp: あなたのヨダレくらいなら、<CR>私は気にならないから大丈夫
records.en_original: Besides, I wouldn't mind if you had drooled on me.
records.en: Besides, I wouldn't mind if you had drooled on me.

records.jp: そ、そこは気にしてほしい……
records.en_original: I-I kinda wish you would mind...
records.en: I-I kinda wish you would mind...

records.jp: あったかくてふわふわして、<CR>天国みたいだった〜
records.en_original: It was so warm and soft... That must be what heaven feels like.
records.en: It was so warm and soft... That must be what heaven feels like.

records.jp: そう。<CR>それなら私たち、おあいこになるわね
records.en_original: I see. That makes us even, then.
records.en: I see. That makes us even, then.

records.jp: へ？
records.en_original: Huh?
records.en: Huh?

records.jp: 細くて可愛くて、守ってあげたくなるみたいで。<CR>とても安心して眠れた
records.en_original: I slept very peacefully too. You're so small and cute I felt like I was protecting you.
records.en: I slept very peacefully too. You're so small and cute I felt like I was protecting you.

records.jp: ふにゃ〜
records.en_original: D'aww...
records.en: D'aww...

records.jp: それに、このベッドの星空も<CR>悪くないような気がしてきたかもしれない
records.en_original: Also, I think I might be coming around to this bed and its night sky.
records.en: Also, I think I might be coming around to this bed and its night sky.

records.jp: 愛央とこうして眺めてるのが、本物の星空なら<CR>とても素敵なことに思えて
records.en_original: Gazing up at it together like this, it reminds me of how wonderful the real night sky is.
records.en: Gazing up at it together like this, it reminds me of how wonderful the real night sky is.

records.jp: わ、私もそう思う！
records.en_original: M-me too!
records.en: M-me too!

records.jp: フラグメント「<CLGR>%s<CLNR>」を<CR>手に入れました
records.en_original: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
records.en: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
